blocks.prompt: 10 Solve the following trigonometric equation: \(\cos 2x = \cos x\)
blocks.explanation:
Phir do alag angles: \(2x\) aur \(x\). Right side par \(\cos x\) hai, is liye \(\cos 2x\) ki woh shakal chunenge jis mein sirf cosine ho: \(2\cos^{2}x - 1\).
Is se \(\cos x\) mein quadratic ban jayegi.
Find kya karna hai? Principal solutions aur general solution.
Plan: formula, sab ek taraf, factorise, \(\cos x = 1\) aur \(\cos x = -\frac{1}{2}\) hal karo.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(\cos 2x = \cos x\).
Maloom karna: principal solutions aur general solution.
Tareeqa: \(\cos 2x = 2\cos^{2}x - 1\) rakh kar \(\cos x\) mein quadratic hal karenge.

Double-angle formula lagayein
\[2\cos^{2}x - 1 = \cos x\]
\[2\cos^{2}x - \cos x - 1 = 0\]
Kyun: \(\cos 2x\) ki teen shaklein hain (\(\cos^{2}x - \sin^{2}x\), \(2\cos^{2}x - 1\), \(1 - 2\sin^{2}x\)). Right side par cosine hai, is liye sirf cosine wali shakal chuni taa ke equation ek hi ratio mein rahe.

Factorise karein
\[2\cos^{2}x - 2\cos x + \cos x - 1 = 0\]
\[2\cos x(\cos x - 1) + 1(\cos x - 1) = 0\]
\[(2\cos x + 1)(\cos x - 1) = 0\]
Kyun: humein product \(2 \times (-1) = -2\) aur sum \(-1\) wale numbers chahiye: \(-2\) aur \(+1\). Phir \((\cos x - 1)\) common nikal aaya.

Do basic equations
\[\cos x = -\dfrac{1}{2}\ \text{ or }\ \cos x = 1\]
Kyun: har factor ko zero rakha: \(2\cos x + 1 = 0\) se \(\cos x = -\frac{1}{2}\), aur \(\cos x - 1 = 0\) se \(\cos x = 1\). Dono values \(-1\) aur \(1\) ke andar hain, to dono cases jaaiz hain; koi case rad nahin karna. Yeh bilkul Question 5 jaisa kaam hai.

Jab \(\cos x = 1\)
\[x = 0,\ 2\pi\]
\([0, 2\pi]\) mein; aam taur par \(x = 2n\pi\).
Kyun: cosine sirf circle ke shuru wale point par 1 hota hai; band interval ki wajah se 0 aur \(2\pi\) dono likhe.

Jab \(\cos x = -\frac{1}{2}\)
Cosine negative: quadrant II aur III, reference angle \(\frac{\pi}{3}\).
\[x = \pi - \dfrac{\pi}{3} = \dfrac{2\pi}{3}\]
\[x = \pi + \dfrac{\pi}{3} = \dfrac{4\pi}{3}\]
Kyun: reference angle positive value \(\frac{1}{2}\) se aata hai, \(\cos\frac{\pi}{3} = \frac{1}{2}\); minus sign ne quadrant II aur III chune.

General solution
\[\left\{2n\pi\right\}\]
\[\cup \left\{\dfrac{2\pi}{3} + 2n\pi\right\}\]
\[\cup \left\{\dfrac{4\pi}{3} + 2n\pi\right\},\ n \in \mathbb{Z}\]
Kyun: cosine ka period \(2\pi\) hai. Ek khoobsurat baat: \(0, \frac{2\pi}{3}, \frac{4\pi}{3}\) barabar faasle (\(\frac{2\pi}{3}\)) par hain, is liye poora jawab ek line mein \(x = \frac{2n\pi}{3}\) bhi likha ja sakta hai.

Tasdeeq
\[x = \dfrac{2\pi}{3}:\ \cos\dfrac{4\pi}{3} = -\dfrac{1}{2} = \cos\dfrac{2\pi}{3}\]
\[x = 0:\ \cos 0 = 1 = \cos 0\]
Kyun: dono taraf barabar aaye. \(\frac{4\pi}{3}\) par \(2x = \frac{8\pi}{3}\) aur \(\cos\frac{8\pi}{3} = \cos\frac{2\pi}{3} = -\frac{1}{2}\), woh bhi theek.
blocks.final_answer: Principal solutions \([0, 2\pi]\) mein: \(x = 0, \frac{2\pi}{3}, \frac{4\pi}{3}, 2\pi\). General solution: \(\left\{2n\pi\right\}\) \(\cup\) \(\left\{\frac{2\pi}{3} + 2n\pi\right\}\) \(\cup\) \(\left\{\frac{4\pi}{3} + 2n\pi\right\}\), \(n \in \mathbb{Z}\). (ya ek line mein \(x = \frac{2n\pi}{3}\), \(n \in \mathbb{Z}\))

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text: Kitab mein Exercise 10.1 ke jawab chhape hue nahin hain. Is page ka har jawab hamara apna hai: qadam ba qadam hal kiya gaya, computer algebra system (sympy) se alag se check kiya gaya, aur ek solution book se bhi milaya gaya. Kitab ke examples ki tarah hum principal solutions \([0, 2\pi]\) mein aur general solution sets ke union ki shakal mein dete hain. Aap apna kaam yahan wale hal se mila kar dekh sakte hain.
